row.team_price_text: From $49/mo (monthly billing, 7k monthly sessions; 20% off when paid annually); not priced per user
row.evidence: hotjar.com/pricing now redirects to Contentsquare pricing, where "Adv. Security & Administration" ("Use SCIM provisioning to add and remove teammates directly from your identity management app") is marked for Enterprise only.
row.notes: Hotjar has merged into Contentsquare: hotjar.com/pricing redirects to contentsquare.com/pricing, and Hotjar accounts move to the Contentsquare Growth plan unless the owner opts out. Standalone Hotjar offered SAML SSO on the Observe/Ask Scale plans and no SCIM; neither help centre has a SCIM article. On the Contentsquare pricing page, SCIM is mentioned only in the Product Analytics comparison row 'Adv. Security & Administration', marked Enterprise-only. SAML SSO is Pro and Enterprise (Free and Growth get Google OAuth only), with JIT account creation. Pricing is per monthly session, not per user, and adding team members costs nothing, so the per-user fields are null. Row renamed to Hotjar (Contentsquare) under the post-pilot rebrand rule (slug kept), since Hotjar is now sold as part of Contentsquare. Confidence raised from low to high because the Contentsquare pricing page itself marks SCIM Enterprise-only (read from the page's embedded plan data). The SWA-only Okta app maps to idp.okta none.

plans.name: Contentsquare Growth
plans.price_text: Starting from $49 (monthly billing; 7k monthly sessions; 20% discount when paid annually)

limitations.text: The only public mention of SCIM is a feature description on the Contentsquare pricing page (Product Analytics table, Enterprise only); there is no public SCIM documentation on help.hotjar.com or support.contentsquare.com.
Standalone Hotjar documents SAML SSO (Scale plans) with invite-based team management and no SCIM.

rate_limits.text: 3000 requests per minute (50 per second) per source address (Hotjar API)

limitations.text: The documented Hotjar API (Scale plans) covers survey responses and end-user lookup/deletion for GDPR (e.g. POST /v1/organizations/:organization_id/user-lookup); it has no team-member management endpoints. Contentsquare's own APIs were not reviewed.
Hotjar API keys expire after one year and cannot be extended.

okta.notes: Okta's Hotjar app has only SWA checked in its page markup (no SAML or SCIM).

searched: help.hotjar.com and support.contentsquare.com help-centre search: scim (no articles)
open_questions: Is SCIM on Contentsquare Enterprise platform-wide (covering Experience Analytics, the Hotjar successor) or only for Product Analytics? The pricing page lists it only in the Product Analytics comparison row.

No public SCIM documentation found (help-centre search for 'SCIM' returns nothing on help.hotjar.com or support.contentsquare.com); endpoints, attributes, deprovisioning behaviour and IdP support are unknown.
The pricing text says SCIM can 'add and remove teammates'; whether removal deactivates or deletes is not stated.
Pro and Enterprise prices are not published; Growth's $49 is the monthly-billing starting price per session tier, not per user.

help.hotjar.com HTML pages return 403 (Cloudflare); article content was read through the public Zendesk Help Center JSON API on the same domain. The Contentsquare pricing page is JS-rendered; quotes come from its embedded page data.

Google, OneLogin and JumpCloud catalogue entries for Hotjar/Contentsquare could not be confirmed (JumpCloud returned 403, OneLogin blocked, no Google page found). Entra has no Hotjar tutorial (404); the Entra entry is for 'Contentsquare SSO'.
Okta's Hotjar app is SWA-only (last updated 2016); okta.sso recorded false for SAML.
